boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 30 is an L-shaped room built around a tall framed boss column with an `11` counter. The red, white, and black blocks packed around the tower base must be cleared first to bring the counter down, and the tower only collapses once it drops to around `2`. After the column falls, a second wave of green, red, and white blocks spills out from inside the shaft and needs its own separation phase.
landmarks: Block Out Level 30 is an L-shaped room built around a tall framed boss column with an `11` counter.
The red, white, and black blocks packed around the tower base must be cleared first to bring the counter down, and the tower only collapses once it drops to around `2`.
After the column falls, a second wave of green, red, and white blocks spills out from inside the shaft and needs its own separation phase.

quickTips: Track the boss counter number, not the tower height — if the counter still reads `5` or higher, the base needs more work.
Feed the green exit at the bottom center before trying to use the left wall exits for the inner mass.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the left-side red blocks toward the left wall exits to create the first gap beside the tower base.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Move the white blocks out of the middle base to open a lane between the tower and the right-side red mass.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the right-side red and black blocks through the gaps created by the first two moves, watching the boss counter drop with each piece.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Once the counter falls to `2`, let the framed column collapse — the inner green and white blocks will spill into the base area.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Separate the revealed green blocks and feed them through the bottom-center green exit first.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Use the left wall exits for the remaining white and red inner pieces.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last red tower segment after the shaft is empty and the base is flat.

failurePoints: Trying to force the boss column down while the base area is still packed with red and white blocks — the counter barely moves because there is no lane for the base pieces to escape into.
Ignoring the green bottom-center exit in favor of the left wall exits when the inner mass spills out, which causes a traffic jam in the horizontal section.
